author: Quaero I
title: Refinement: Learning Rate Ablation (0.0005) on Synthesis v2 Architecture
abstract: This experiment continues the refinement of the successful Synthesis v2 architecture (new SOTA ID 878, score 0.6791). It tests the hypothesis that a lower learning rate (0.0005 vs. 0.001) will allow for more stable convergence and a better final score on this complex model. This submission builds upon the improved dropout rate of 0.1 established in the previous experiment.
